what: Tagged a release before any batch had run on the tagged code; the release build then hung for 75+ min on a table-heavy supplement, forcing a second tag and a third rebuild.
root_cause: The release gate was tests + make validate only; the slowest real input was never converted from the release candidate.
prevention: Before tagging, convert the batch's slowest / most table-dense PDF from the working tree into scratch and confirm it finishes; if no paper finishes in 15 min, sample GPU memory twice a minute apart - climbing memory means runaway generation, stop it.

what: The ligature repair ran after the markdown export, so the markdown kept 'speci fi city' while the HTML was fixed; caught only on a later spot-check.
root_cause: Verified the fix in one export (HTML) instead of every export that carries the text.
prevention: After any text fix, grep its marker in every export of a converted bundle: <stem>.html, <stem>.md, <stem>.embedded.md and chunks.jsonl.

what: A verification run of rebuild_document_html wrote 19 new HTML files into the user's untouched samples/S_20pdfs_out bundles.
root_cause: Pointed a writing helper at a user folder to measure something.
prevention: Run any script that writes (rebuild_document_html, amir-batch) only on a scratch copy unless the user asked for that folder; ls the target before the run.

what: A coverage check imported the main checkout instead of the worktree under test and reported the fix as still failing.
root_cause: sys.path[0] is the script's folder (or the cwd for stdin), which shadows PYTHONPATH and the editable install differently than assumed.
prevention: Print the imported module's __file__ before trusting any worktree run; run from inside the worktree with PYTHONPATH=<worktree>.

what: Drafted the showcase license notice claiming the PDF was the arXiv preprint 'included unmodified'; it was the authors' Word export.
root_cause: Stated a file's provenance without checking the file.
prevention: Before writing provenance into a license or README, check the file itself (pdfinfo producer/creation date, arXiv stamp on page 1).
